No failures — the pre-existing warnings are unrelated to this fix. The bug is fixed and verified.

## Summary

Root cause: `PostResource.toArray()` (`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`) never included the `excerpt` field, even though `PostResourceData` declared it as a required string. Every page that renders through this resource — `posts/Index`, `posts/Show`, and `posts/Edit` (all fed the same resource JSON) — received `excerpt: undefined`, so the excerpt paragraph rendered empty and the edit form's field came up blank, failing validation on save. The raw DB column and search (which queries `posts.excerpt` directly, bypassing the resource) were unaffected, matching the reported symptoms exactly.

Fix: added `excerpt: post.excerpt as string,` to `toArray()` in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`.

Also added a regression test (`tests/PostController.test.ts`, `describe('post excerpts', ...)`) that creates a post via the model and asserts the Inertia props for both `/posts` and `/posts/:id` include the correct `excerpt` value, so this can't silently regress again.

`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (3 pass, 0 fail) both succeed, and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
